ns2:course.label: Health, Wellness, and the Black Experience
ns2:course.description: Exploration of issues relating to health in African American communities such as environment, lifestyle, chronic disease, intervention, research, policy, social justice and cultural experience. Includes experiential learning projects as part of the Grand Challenge Learning Initiative.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Grand Challenge-Health/Well, Social & Beh Sci - Soc Sci, and Cultural Studies - US Minority course.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: This course is intended for first and second year students.
